note: Plain mode reads the card-art tiles on 20 Nov 2026: /en-sg/credit-cards/ has 7 tiles (Platinum Card, Platinum Reserve, Platinum Credit Card, KrisFlyer, KrisFlyer Ascend, PPS Club, and the Singapore Airlines Business Credit Card, which is a business card and is skipped).
